name: Taqueria Don Chamango
notes: 4 photos: 1 = main yellow taco/burrito board (most items, used as sourceUrl); 2 = fruteria/raspados board (numbered snack/fruit-cup items); 3 & 4 = printed nachos/tortas/quesadillas/fries flyers with many prices covered by colored tape stickers (price omitted where illegible). Merged duplicate categories (tortas, quesadillas, nachos, fries) across photos 1/3/4. A few ambiguous handwritten prices (menudo, chicken nuggets, chile relleno plate) were dropped rather than guessed.
